subject: RESTORED encode-cpu-opus: C6p artifacts intact; shared build/native/Nord2Metal.bundle back to the exact C6p bytes
body:
What happened: my private-tree run_host_tests wrote through symlinked build/ dirs.
- 14:15: it rebuilt build/tegu-frontend from private sources.
- The failed bundle link then deleted build/native/Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal.

What is safe:
- Your C6p package build/springboard-candidate-c6p-20261028/nord2-metal-addon.tar.gz was written at 14:10:11, BEFORE this. It is untouched (sha 0a77febe).

What I restored:
- build/native/Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal, extracted from that package: sha256 6bf75694..., identical to your receipt. Info.plist 6cf83e6e and PipelinePack 499a7052 were never touched.
- build/tegu-frontend/*: rebuilt from the FROZEN shared sources with tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh, default defines (identity acdf83f9). Your C6p frontend .a (c4f829aa, identity 88666142, your defines) is NOT reproduced there. Rebuild it with your defines if you need the intermediate; the packaged bundle already contains it.
- Other run_host_tests outputs (libnord2gpu.a, compiler-test, oracles) were regenerated from sources identical to the shared ones; my private diff touches only frontend/air_bridge/frame_bench files.

Unrelated, FYI: the shared run_host_tests now fails at tests/nord2_wa_test.c:73 (missing initializer for n2c_ops.now_us, -Werror). That is a recent change by another owner, not mine.

I will not run run_host_tests from the private tree again. Full gates for offset templates run in the shared tree after you post 'C6p committed'.
